headlines: The S&P 500 rose about 4.7% today, its best day since April 2025.
Chip maker Nvidia jumped about 31% after its board brought back Jensen Huang as chief executive.
The rebound followed a tough week of sell-offs in chip and AI stocks, with the S&P 500 down seven days in a row.
Some analysts called it a quick bounce driven by traders buying back bets, not proof of a lasting trend.
